change_summary: scan_repository now runs each value pattern once over a whole decoded blob (matching offsets mapped back to line numbers) instead of five finditer passes per line, with a cheap boolean shape predicate ahead of each pattern and an offset-anchored email scan. Bounded-work, OOXML/PDF and skip bookkeeping are unchanged.

equivalence.method: In one process the exact pre-change per-line algorithm is injected over the module's _inspect_text and both scans run over the same tree; reports are compared field by field and by report body.
equivalence.email_boundary_checks: 64-character local part found, 65-character local part not found, stray '@' not found, two mailboxes on one line both found

corpus.container_inflation: two PDF supplements inflate to ~21-23 MB of stream text each

not_reached: The 2 s target is not reached: the floor is set by full coverage of ~185 MB of decoded text (a 29 MB generated lint log plus ~70 MB of inflated PDF stream text), whose classification requires at least one pattern scan each. Reported rather than traded away; no exemption or scope change was made.
unchanged_by_design: OOXML/PDF extraction and the opaque/oversize/unreadable skip reasons
